Inspecteur,\n\nBienvenue à la Section 4,:
Inspector,

Welcome to Section 4, Civil File Inspection. Your assignment takes effect today.

To start you off, a routine check is waiting for you: file no. 40000. Nothing serious — a chance to get your hand in. A real file, no. 40921, will follow straight after.

The Personnel Directorate has attached a memo: who does what at the Ministry, what the Militia is, Section 7, VERITAS. Read it, it will save you a few missteps.

Examine the documents methodically. Trust no document on its own.

The Ministry judges its agents on their results, but also on their discernment.

R. MAZUR
Note de service n° 86-114 : système VERI: Service memo no. 86-114: the VERITAS system
À l'attention de l'ensemble des agents.\:
For the attention of all agents.

The VERITAS analysis system is now connected to the Section 4 terminals. It will assist inspectors in cross-checking documents.

VERITAS recommendations are provided for guidance only. Responsibility for conclusions lies with the signing agent.

VIGILANCE IS A CIVIC DUTY.
Direction du personnel, Ministère de la: Personnel Directorate, Ministry of National Security
À l'attention des agents nouvellement af:
For the attention of newly assigned agents.

THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL SECURITY: your employer. It keeps a file on every citizen.

SECTION 4, Inspection of Civil Files: your department. You are given the files of citizens who have been reported; you examine them and sign a conclusion. Your direct superior is R. MAZUR, deputy director.

SECTION 7: surveillance and censorship. It keeps the records, redoes identity cards, issues summonses and puts up seals.

THE MILITIA: the regime's police, organised by district ("District 9 Militia"). It makes the arrests, searches homes and pays informers. Many reports come from it. It has a long memory, and does not like an inspector proving it wrong.

THE PARTY: the single party. Membership protects you; expulsion closes doors.

VERITAS: the analysis system on your terminal. It cross-checks the records and recommends a conclusion. It signs nothing: you are the one who signs.

THE PERSONNEL DIRECTORATE: it assesses agents. Your assessment opens with the Personnel icon, from your second day.

HALVEK: the border town. Travel to Halvek is watched.

RELIABILITY OF DOCUMENTS: A, reliable source; B, usually reliable; C, unreliable; D, unverified. A single document proves nothing.

YOUR DAY: eight hours of duty, from 08h00 to 16h00. When your work is done, or your hours are used up, click END OF SHIFT, at the bottom right of the screen. A file without a conclusion will wait for you the next day, but your superiors will notice.

YOUR MAIL AND YOUR FILES: a letter you have read can be deleted (DELETE button); a concluded file can be filed away (FILE AWAY button). Nothing is lost: the bin and the filed cases can still be consulted.

VIGILANCE IS A CIVIC DUTY.
